title: TTD gardens get AI boost in proposed maintenance plan
description: TTD plans to use artificial intelligence to improve the development and maintenance of Tirumala’s 34 gardens. A temple official said 20 gardens are maintained by donors and 14 by the administration, while floral displays during Srivari Brahmotsavams drew appreciation

title: Tip: Get more access to Gemini 4 Argon through Google Search's AI Mode
description: Even paying users quickly hit their subscription's usage limits with Google's latest AI model. Those who do not want to upgrade to a more expensive plan can get more out of their subscription by accessing it through Google Search.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Its Potential to Distort Reality
description: Researchers are sounding the alarm about the dangers of artificial intelligence-generated content, which can distort people's memories and lead to false recollections.

title: AI Agents Are Killing the Git Client, Not Git: What Anthropic's Scion and Cursor's Origin Show
description: Anthropic replaced Git with Scion; Cursor launched Origin. Why AI agents make the Git client obsolete, which orgs should leave Git, and what GitHub must do.
